provider: TitleTech of Arkansas, LLC (independent title/closing company, home office Rogers, AR/Benton County-NWA; embeds a NetSheetCalc/TitleTap white-label net-sheet calculator instance, app_id=393)
calculatorUrl: https://app.netsheetcalc.com/c/titletech-title (splash) -> Quick Quote at https://app.netsheetcalc.com/company/quickquote.php?appid=393 (no sign-in needed, though the UI page itself is a JS-rendered shell with no static form -- the data endpoints below were driven directly)
endpoint: GET https://app.netsheetcalc.com/company/non-auth-ajax.php?action=getAppData&app_id=393 (no auth) returns this agency's full fee-form JSON schema, including hardcoded flat-dollar ancillary fee constants (closing_fee, search fee, cpl, eFiling_fee_estimate, recording_fee, technology fee, mobile notary); GET https://app.netsheetcalc.com/api/index.php/rate/<amount>/<rate-key> (no auth) returns this agency's own dynamically-rated title insurance premium and transfer-tax ('Revenue Stamps') figures for a given dollar amount, rate keys 'finance393' (title insurance premium, keyed off purchase price per this tool's own formula reference for both the owner's and lender's premium fields), 'cash393', and 'Revenue393' (revenue stamps/transfer tax) specific to this tenant.
scenario: $500,000 purchase price, $400,000 loan, residential purchase with financing ('finance' estimate type), buyer paying for owner's title insurance policy. This tool has no county/city selector at all (a free-text city/state/zip field only, no dropdown or county-based fee branching found anywhere in the schema) -- its ancillary fee constants are flat statewide, so Pulaski County/Little Rock (AR's most-populous county, the mission's standard-scenario target) was not a substitutable input; the company's own home office is in Rogers, AR (Benton County, Northwest Arkansas), not Pulaski County.
methodology: Found via web search for Arkansas-specific title-company rate calculators (search snippet: 'Calculator - TitleTech of Arkansas LLC.'); confirmed genuinely Arkansas-specific by the company's own name/domain (titletech-arkansas.io), distinguishing it from several other app.netsheetcalc.com appids that surfaced in Arkansas-flavored search snippets but were confirmed via this same getAppData recipe to actually default to TX/IL/FL/no-state configurations (appids 523, 462, 444 respectively) -- a misattribution pattern matching the one already documented for South Carolina in the 2026-07-30 session, guarded against here by verifying each candidate's own JSON config before treating it as a real state match. The calculator page itself embeds NetSheetCalc's widget.v2.js with a static '__widget_app_data' script tag exposing app_id=393 directly in the page HTML (no iframe-hunting needed). No personal data fields (name/email/phone) exist anywhere in the fee-form schema.
